narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -4.41 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.6225-0.6254 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.6285; the first objective pays 0.74R at 0.6195.

plan.triggerRule: footprint sdiv fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.6285 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 38/100 — liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
